rationale: The two solutions are essentially the same: the same constants, the same coordinate validation, the same stack-based flood fill collecting bordering stone colours, and the same territories aggregation. The differences are purely cosmetic. A uses rows/cols with a continue guard and a one-line conditional expression for the owner, while B uses width/height with a nested if and an explicit if/else, and returns parenthesized tuples. A also leaves a stray blank line at the top of the file. Neither is meaningfully clearer, more idiomatic or more robust than the other.
